title: The Clocktower

reward.description: A silver pocket watch that runs exactly four minutes fast, as all good watches should.

hints: Hours 13-23 chime hour - 12 times. Hours 0 and 12 both chime 12 times.
For chime_pattern, make a list of 'BONG' words and join them, or use string multiplication carefully.
total_chimes can call chimes() inside a loop: for hour in range(start, end + 1): ...
